info.title: AEON Astrophysical OS API
info.description: Frozen data contract shared by every AEON service. 11 paths. Owners: core = /backend (FastAPI, Astropy, Photutils, REBOUND, DuckDB); ai = /ai-engine; missions = /multi-mission-api. All services are mounted behind one Nginx gateway under /api/v1. Changing this file requires a PR reviewed by the repo lead (@alpztel).

get.summary: Name resolution or cone search over the DuckDB catalog
get.description: Provide either `q` (name / designation / id, case-insensitive) or `ra`+`dec` (+ `radius_arcmin`). Field sources from the sky model are appended when `include_field=true`.

parameters.name: epoch
parameters.description: Positions are propagated to this epoch; default is mid-survey 2026.5

200.description: Matches ordered by separation (cone) or relevance (name)

get.summary: Calibrated image cutout (FITS pipeline) at one epoch and band

parameters.name: band
parameters.description: Band index 0..101, or omitted for the broadband (all-band mean) image

200.description: Image as JSON (row-major float array, row 0 = south) or as a FITS file with WCS header

get.summary: 102-band SPHEREx-like spectrum (0.75-5.0 um) by aperture photometry on a spectral cube

parameters.name: epoch
parameters.description: Survey epoch. Omitted: the epoch with the best real SPHEREx data at this position (the most measured bands, then the highest median S/N; a catalog object is followed to where it is in each epoch); the choice and every candidate are in pipeline.epoch_selection.

post.summary: Image analysis: difference imaging, shift-and-stack, or blind 5x5 velocity grid search
REBOUND N-body forecast (Sun + Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune + test particle)

200.description: Trajectories in heliocentric ecliptic J2000, AU

post.summary: Astro-LLM: natural language (TR/EN) to UI actions via function calling

context.description: Current UI state: ra, dec, epoch, selected target, active modes

200.description: Reply text plus ordered UI actions

post.summary: 1D-CNN spectral classifier (5 classes) and PatchAnomalyViT image anomaly score

ra.description: ICRS right ascension (deg); used with dec when flux_ujy is absent

spectrum_source.description: request: flux_ujy from the request; archive: read from the core backend by (ra, dec); none: the backend has no usable spectrum at this position; unavailable: the backend could not be reached or did not answer in time (retry later). For none and unavailable the probabilities are an uninformative uniform prior

spectrum_snr_median.description: Median per-band S/N of the archive spectrum (null otherwise)

spectrum_data_mode.description: archive only: fits_archive = real SPHEREx data; physical_model = the backend's model of the catalog object (no real data at this position)

spectrum_epoch.description: archive only: epoch of the classified spectrum (the backend picks the epoch with the best real data)

spectrum_observed_quarter.description: archive only: calendar quarter really observed, e.g. 2025-Q4 (2025 frames are filed under the 2026 quarter of the same season)

spectrum_bands_measured.description: archive only: AEON bands measured by real SPHEREx frames (of 102)

spectrum_bands_blended.description: archive only: measured bands whose aperture light is centred on a neighbour (backend pipeline.blended)

spectrum_bands_used.description: Bands classified as the target's own (measured, not blended) when some were not; null = the spectrum was used as served

classification_input.description: measured, or how many usable bands were kept and which template filled the others

physics_agrees.description: Whether the 1D-CNN class equals the physics template fitted to the same bands (the CNN is trained on synthetic spectra)

physics_diagnostics.description: Physics of the classified spectrum (null without a spectrum)

teff_k.description: Nearest template temperature; null when not measurable (teff_method)

image_provided.description: false: no image was sent; the ZOGY numbers are zeros, not a measurement

post.description: Send at least one of flux_ujy, image, or the pair (ra, dec). With only (ra, dec) the engine reads the 102-band spectrum of that position from the core backend; spectrum_source tells which spectrum was used.

get.summary: Gaia DR3 + WISE cross-match, full SED (0.4-22 um) and MAST JWST/HST overlap

spherex.description: How the SPHEREx part of the SED was built: status real | excluded: physical model | unavailable | none; epoch, observed_quarter, n_points

teff_sed_k.description: Colour temperature (teff_method wien_color_temperature) or, for a solar-system body, the equilibrium temperature (equilibrium)

reflected_color_temperature_k.description: Solar-system body: colour temperature of its reflected sunlight (the Sun's colour, not the body's temperature)

galactic.description: Galactic space velocity w.r.t. the LSR (solar motion 11.1, 12.24, 7.25 km/s, Schoenrich et al. 2010) and population membership (Bensby et al. 2014). Without a measured radial velocity: three solutions (RV -30, 0, +30 km/s) and their envelope, never an invented RV.

inputs.description: Astrometry used, with the source of every value.

age_mass.description: Stage 2: age and mass from a spectral channel (brightness / temperature against Sonora Bobcat and BHAC15 evolution models on a mass-age grid) and a kinematic channel (age-velocity dispersion relation, Aumer & Binney 2009), and their product. A channel without data reports status 'unmeasured' and a reason; no value is filled in.

inputs.description: Measured values the fit used and the assumed uncertainty floors.

spectral.description: Posterior summary of one channel (16-84 % interval).

constraint.description: Width of the interval against the flat prior.

pdf.description: Density per unit age on age_grid_gyr, peak = 1.

kinematic.description: Posterior summary of one channel (16-84 % interval).

constraint.description: Width of the interval against the flat prior.

pdf.description: Density per unit age on age_grid_gyr, peak = 1.

joint.description: Posterior summary of one channel (16-84 % interval).

constraint.description: Width of the interval against the flat prior.

pdf.description: Density per unit age on age_grid_gyr, peak = 1.

degeneracy_track.description: The mass-age degeneracy: the best-fitting mass at each age for the spectral observable alone.

galactic_orbit.description: Stage 3 summary from the core backend (galpy, MWPotential2014): Galactic orbit over +/- 250 Myr and the closest approach to the Sun within +/- 50 kyr. Trajectories come from POST /api/v1/orbit/simulate.

validation.description: Stage 4 scorecard: AEON's result next to SIMBAD astrometry (pushed through the same kinematics and orbit) and peer-reviewed literature values. Verdicts follow a fixed rule (do the intervals overlap); the synthesis text is assembled from the rows only.

get.summary: Recent NASA GCN notices (GRB, supernova, neutrino) for the ticker

post.summary: Submit a new candidate or vote on an existing one; high-confidence submissions open a GitHub Issue

data_mode.description: fits_archive = real FITS files found in AEON_DATA_DIR; physical_model = scientific fallback renderer

is_synthetic.description: True for injected test objects that do not exist on the sky

CatalogObject.description: Positions (ra, dec) are apparent geocentric positions at the requested epoch (proper motion + Earth parallax for objects with a known distance).

data.description: Row-major, length width*height, row 0 = south edge, column 0 = east edge (sky orientation, north up / east left). Units uJy/pixel unless stated.

wcs.description: FITS WCS keywords (CTYPE, CRVAL, CRPIX, CDELT)

provenance.description: Present when the image comes from archive files: source, n_frames, obs_date_range, obs_decimal_year_mean, coverage, masked flags, per-frame info.

depth.description: Fractional depth relative to continuum fit, 0..1

measured.description: Per band: true = real measurement; false = interpolated fill (NOT a measurement; plot differently, e.g. hollow markers).

rate_arcsec_yr.description: shift-stack: heliocentric angular rate (arcsec/yr). With distance_au set, the apparent (geocentric) track adds Earth's reflex parallax.

pa_deg.description: shift-stack: position angle of motion, deg east of north

distance_au.description: shift-stack: trial geocentric distance in AU for Earth-parallax digital tracking. null = no parallax (linear motion only, appropriate for objects beyond ~10^4 AU or parallax-corrected frames).

distance_range_au.description: blind-search: distance range searched on a grid uniform in parallax (1/d), spaced so the parallax mismatch stays below ~1.2 px. null = no distance axis (no parallax).

cadence.description: shift-stack / blind-search frame times: uniform over 2026, or only while the field's solar elongation is 90 +- 10 deg (SPHEREx-like visit windows).

dt_years_observed.description: True baseline between the mean observation dates of the two archive images (may differ from dt_years, which uses nominal quarter centres).

t_ref.description: Reference epoch (decimal year) at which the stacked image is registered

motion_frame.description: 'geocentric (Earth parallax tracked)' when distance_au is set, otherwise 'heliocentric (no parallax)'

track.description: Predicted apparent (geocentric) position of the hypothesis at each frame time

astrometry.description: Independent positions measured on sub-stacks of consecutive frames along the track; usable as orbit/simulate detections.

grid.description: S/N indexed [rate_index][pa_index], at the best distance

refined.description: Finer grid centred on the coarse optimum

distances_au.description: Distance grid searched (null when no distance axis)

distance_profile.description: Best S/N over the rate x PA grid at each distance

OrbitRequest.description: One of detections, elements, observation, galactic or target_id. Solar-system bodies are integrated with REBOUND (heliocentric); stars and brown dwarfs with galpy in the Milky Way potential (regime 'galactic'). regime 'auto' picks by the input: a galactic block, or a target_id whose catalog entry has a distance in parsec, is Galactic.

detections.description: Geocentric astrometry; a heliocentric state is fitted by least squares (Earth parallax included) and forecast with REBOUND.

galactic.description: Astrometry of a star or brown dwarf (ICRS).

radial_velocity_km_s.description: Omit or null when not measured: the orbit is then integrated for -30, 0 and +30 km/s and reported as an envelope, never with an invented value.

span_myr.description: Galactic regime: integrate this far into the past and the future.

encounter_kyr.description: Galactic regime: window searched for the closest approach to the Sun.

fit.description: Orbit-determination summary when detections were given

galactic.description: Galactic regime only (particle is then empty and planets is []): orbit in MWPotential2014 and the closest approach to the Sun.

orbits.description: One per radial velocity (one if measured, three for the envelope).

t_min_kyr.description: Time of closest approach, kyr from now (negative: past).

summary.description: A number when the radial velocity is measured, a [min, max] envelope otherwise.
